plain: It moves across the sky: about 2.30 arcseconds per year, measured over 17 years (a very confident measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = 2.90 mag is extremely red, like the coldest brown dwarfs (late-T and Y).
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a T8 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (d_sdT8) fits about as well.
